text: **dsh-search-boost**（DSH 网页客户端插件）：为网页检索、页面阅读和 X 内容查询提供搜索增强。它通过 bundle patch 接管内置 web_search 与 web_fetch，并注册融合搜索、页面抓取、X 搜索、深度研究、并行研究和搜索统计工具。检索可并行调用免费引擎并融合去重结果，也可按需启用 API 引擎；页面工具支持主题聚焦，X 搜索在无凭据时仍有回退流程。适合需要联网查证、阅读网页或汇总多来源资料的 DSH 用户。免费搜索和基础 X 回退无需额外密钥；API 引擎及官方 X 搜索凭据为可选。

**dsh-search-boost** (DSH web plugin) replaces built-in web search and fetch, and adds fused search, focused page reading, X lookup, deep and parallel research, and stats. It combines keyless engines, with optional API engines and official X access. Basic search and X fallback need no key.
想让 DSH 的网页搜索同时查询多个引擎，再合并重复结果。
需要抓取网页正文，并只保留和某个主题相关的段落。
我想搜索 X 帖子、账号资料或指定帖子对应的对话。
帮我对一个问题做多来源检索，指出资料覆盖缺口并建议下一轮查询。
把一个研究问题拆成几个角度，让 DSH 子代理并行收集来源。
我希望可以在免费搜索层和带 API 的搜索层之间切换。
需要把网页搜索与抓取接到 DSH 内置 provider，同时保留引用卡片。
I want DSH to combine results from several web search engines.
Find recent X posts or profile details even when I have no X API credentials.
Split a broad research question among DSH subagents and collect their sources.
**dsh-search-boost** 的功能「融合网页搜索」：并行查询多个引擎，按复杂度选择预算并合并去重结果。通过 fused_search 工具触发，可指定域名、时效、引擎和结果数。
**dsh-search-boost**「替换内置搜索」：bundle patch 将 web_search 与 web_fetch 指向插件 provider，并输出 DSH 网页引用卡片。启动对应 profile 后自动触发。
**dsh-search-boost** 的功能「聚焦抓取网页」：读取单个 URL 的正文，支持 focus 保留相关段落，并缓存结果。调用 fetch_page，输入 URL 与可选主题，输出文本内容。
**dsh-search-boost** 的功能「X 搜索」：按关键词、语义、用户或帖子标识查询 X 内容；可并行合并官方搜索与网页引擎，缺凭据时使用 guest GraphQL 或 oEmbed 回退。
**dsh-search-boost** 的功能「深度研究轮次」：对研究问题执行复杂度搜索，标注词项覆盖、跨域佐证、缺口和建议查询。通过 deep_research 输入问题并据返回建议继续调用。
**dsh-search-boost** 的功能「并行多代理研究」：将问题拆分为多个角度，启动 DSH 子代理并行研究，合并输出来源。调用 research_parallel，传入问题及可选子查询和时间预算。
**dsh-search-boost** 的功能「搜索层切换」：用 /web_change free 选择无 key 引擎，或用 api 启用可用的完整引擎池；show 显示当前层和引擎状态。
**dsh-search-boost** 的功能「注入搜索守则」：通过 systemPrompt.section 加入搜索优先策略和工具路由说明，引导 DSH 使用搜索、抓取与研究工具。插件加载时自动注册。
**dsh-search-boost** 的功能「搜索统计」：search_stats 展示当前层、引擎可用性、缓存命中、复杂度分布和最近查询。调用无参数工具即可查看会话统计。
dsh-search-boost 使用 fetch_page 时，目标页面 URL 会发给 r.jina.ai 优先提取正文；Jina 返回失败或内容过短时才尝试本地抓取。
dsh-search-boost 的搜索查询会发送给所选搜索引擎；X 查询还会请求 X/xAI 服务。API 引擎和官方 X 路径按配置启用。

dsh-search-boost README · dsh-search-boost：Search engines live in **`lib/`**: on the **free** layer, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Yahoo, and Exa-free run in parallel; the **api** layer adds Antigravity CLI (when available) and keyed Tavily / Brave / Exa when keys are present (one key is enough; all three recommended for best fusion).

dsh-search-boost README · Search layers：Two layers, switched at runtime with `/web_change` (persisted to `~/.dsh-search-boost-layer.json`):

dsh-search-boost README · Search layers：| Layer | Engines dialed | When to use |
|---|---|---|
| **`free`** (keyless only) | **Bing + DuckDuckGo + Yahoo + Exa MCP (exa-free)** — all live-probed, no API keys | Research loops, zero-cost runs, privacy-conscious use |
| **`api`** (default) | Same keyless legs **plus** Antigravity CLI (when `agy` is on PATH) and keyed **Tavily / Brave / Exa** (when keys are present) | Maximum recall; cross-engine corroboration with paid APIs |

dsh-search-boost README · Search layers：Keyless engines run **in parallel** so one failure never leaves you empty-handed. Fused ranking adds cross-engine co-occurrence scoring and half-life time-decay freshness.

dsh-search-boost README · Features：| Capability | Description |
|---|---|
| **Built-in `web_search` + `web_fetch` upgrade** | Registers `WebSearchProvider` + `WebFetchProvider` and patches both seam configs, so built-in search/fetch keep native citation cards while the backend runs on this plugin's engine chain and Jina-first page reader |
| `fused_search` | Multi-engine fused retrieval with complexity routing, Grok-style query preprocessing (`site:` / `OR` / quotes), domain filters, cross-engine scoring, and 6h TTL cache. Active layer via `/web_change`; per-call `layer` override supported |
| `/web_change` | `/web_change free` → keyless pool only; `/web_change api` → full pool; `/web_change show` → current layer + engine availability |
| `x_search` | Real-time X/Twitter: posts, users, threads. With credentials: hosted xAI tool ∥ multi-engine (site:x.com), merged and deduped. **Without credentials**: multi-engine + oEmbed full text (~2s), guest GraphQL user profiles, oEmbed threads. `/x-login` / `/x-logout` toggle the official path |
| `/x-login` | Import xAI credentials into `~/.dsh-search-boost-xauth.json` (from `~/.grok/auth.json` or `-k <XAI_API_KEY>`). OIDC auto-refresh; grok

dsh-search-boost README · Installation (bundle — recommended)：**From npm (recommended):**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-search-boost          # latest
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-search-boost@0.1.3    # pin a version
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-search-boost       # update to a newer release
```

dsh-search-boost README · Installation (bundle — recommended)：`--profile <name>` is **required** (`web` is the standard web-UI profile). DSH uses pnpm to resolve the package, auto-wires the `dsh.bundle.patch` layer, and adds it to the profile's bundle list — no manual config editing. Restart `dsh --profile web`.

**From source (development):**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Mr-remon219/dsh-search-boost
dsh plugin --profile web add git+file:///path/to/repo
```

Or use the install script (syntax check → key setup → install → verification):

dsh-search-boost README · Installation (bundle — recommended)：```powershell
.\install.ps1          # Windows
./install.sh           # Linux / macOS
```

Verify:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config   # web.searchProvider → dsh-search-boost
dsh --profile web
```

dsh-search-boost README · Troubleshooting: missing `dsh` or `pnpm`：If you run DSH via `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`, there is no global `dsh` binary — install globally or use npx directly:

```sh
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh

dsh-search-boost README · or:：npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-search-boost
```

`dsh plugin` needs **pnpm** (`npm install -g pnpm` or corepack).

dsh-search-boost README · Alternative: session-level dynamic plugin (`plugin-host.js`)：`plugin-host.js` is a single-file dynamic plugin for per-session boosts. It does **not** replace built-in `web_search`. The bundle form (above) is recommended for deployment-level integration.

dsh-search-boost README · Configuration (API keys)：The published bundle contains **no secrets**. Keys load from:

1. `~/.dsh-search-boost-keys.json` or `./.search-boost-keys.json`:

```json
{ "tavily": "tvly-...", "exa": "...", "brave": "..." }
```

2. Environment: `TAVILY_API_KEY` / `EXA_API_KEY` / `BRAVE_API_KEY`

Engines without a key are dropped from the fan-out automatically.

dsh-search-boost README · Configuration (API keys)：**Free layer needs zero configuration.** Bing, DuckDuckGo, Yahoo, and Exa MCP (exa-free) are keyless and run in parallel. Antigravity CLI (`agy`) is optional and only joins in the **`api`** layer (medium/complex tiers) when installed and signed in.

dsh-search-boost README · x_search credentials (optional)：| Command | Effect |
|---|---|
| `/x-login` | Import grok login → official hosted x_search path (SuperGrok / X Premium+ tier) |
| `/x-login -k <XAI_API_KEY>` | Same via console.x.ai API key |
| `/x-login status` | Show credential chain |
| `/x-logout` | Disable official path; fallback chain still works |

`~/.grok/auth.json` is never auto-consumed. Without `/x-login` or `XAI_API_KEY`, `x_search` uses only the credential-free chain.

dsh-search-boost README · Integration scenarios：| Scenario | Result |
|---|---|
| `free` layer fused_search | 5 hits in ~1.3–3.0s; cross-engine corroboration (e.g. yahoo+exa-free → score 3.29 on rust release notes) |
| `x_search` (no credentials) | keyword via multi-engine + oEmbed; user via guest GraphQL (@NASA ~2s); thread via oEmbed |
| SSRF vs Clash TUN fake-ip | Literal 198.18/15 blocked; TUN-routed hostnames allowed (`DSH_SEARCH_ALLOW_TUN_FAKEIP=0` to disable) |
| Headless `web_search` | ✓ free Bing/DDG/Yahoo/Exa chain |
| Unit + E2E tests | 57/57 unit tests; 14/14 black-box E2E |

dsh-search-boost README · Architecture notes：- Runs in the **host process** (Node `fetch` / `child_process` directly).
- HTML scrapers (Bing / DDG / Yahoo) use **IPv4-forced fetch** — undici on Windows defaults to IPv6-first DNS, which intermittently times out against search hosts.
- X search: official path (`lib/xsearch.js`) → credential-free chain (`lib/xfallback.js`: multi-engine + oEmbed + guest GraphQL) with sync preflight when no credentials.

dsh-search-boost README · Files：```
index.js                    — bundle entry (providers + tools + commands + policy)
lib/engines.js              — engine registry (bing / ddg / yahoo / exa-free / …)
lib/exa-free.js             — Exa MCP keyless engine
lib/layer.js                — free/api layer state (/web_change)
